title: Rust sf_assignment module and tests are not compiled or exported
description: rust/lichen-core/src/sf_assignment.rs is absent from lichen-core/src/lib.rs, so its production API and unit tests are orphaned; cargo test filters run zero tests and previously missing imports were invisible. close_reason: Exported sf_assignment from lichen-core; its 7 unit tests now compile and pass.
